title: Vyavuzwe mu Kubaho
intro: Igishushanyo kirasohoka mu mateka meranda, gifise ibitangaro vyari biteye kubiri n’urutonde rw’ibidukikije. Uwo mutima washitse biciye ku itegeko rimwe ry’Imana, urakingira umuvyeyi ibirego bikomeye, maze uva muri iyi si imbere y’uko iminyororo yo kw’isi ibaboha. Inkuru itangura kuva ku nkoko yicishije bugufi gushika mw’ijuru ryo hejuru. None uwo yoba ari nde?
clues: Narungitswe nk’ikimenyetso n’imbabazi zivuye kuri Allah ku bana ba Isirayeli.
Ugushika kwanje kwari gutandukanye n’ukw’imbere — naje kubera ijambo ry’Imana ‘Ba!’. ata se wo kw’isi.
Umuvyeyi wanje yarashikiwe n’ugusebanywa kw’ububisha, ariko ihishurirwa ryera ryamanutse kugira ngo rimenyeshe ko ata caha bafise kandi riduze ikibanza cabo.
Nkiri uruyoya rukiri ruto, naratangaza abo bari bakikuje mu kuvuga neza ndi mu nda kugira ngo nkuremwo izina ry’umuvyeyi wanje.
Kubera uruhusha rwa Allah, narabumvye ubuzima mw’ibumba ritagira ubuzima, ndaha impumyi amaso, nkiza umunyamibembe nkoresheje gukorako kwanje.
Naraduzwe mw’ijuru imbere y’uko ikibi kinkorako, kandi nzosubira muri iyi si imbere y’uko Isaha ya nyuma ishika.

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Bazamuwe mw’ijuru, bazogaruka imbere y’Umusi w’Urubanza .
Yabaye umwami afise ububasha ku ma jini, ku bantu no ku nyoni .
Yarokotse umwuzure munini ari kumwe n’abizera .
outcome.answer: Bazamuwe mw’ijuru, bazogaruka imbere y’Umusi w’Urubanza .

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)
